notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north. Junction paint of the Village area added by hand in the fix-up pass: crosswalks, stop bars, lane lines and arrows, read from the NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px). Method: crosswalk bands found on brightness profiles along the traffic (band width at half height) and across it (each bar's centre; spacing by least squares over the bar numbers, ends at the road edges); transverse crosswalk lines and stop bars fitted as straight lines to the brightness peak on profiles every 0.3 to 0.5 m (rms 0.01 to 0.09 m); arrows only where their shape can be read. The two crosswalks that v_roads drew as stall rows are drawn here as crosswalks and taken out of v_roads.
